ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The right lobe contains a contiguous high-intensity white region with interspersed low-intensity vertical streaks. The left lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with small clusters of medium-intensity grey pixels near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations along the right lobe trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes of 3-7 pixels; the distal tip of the right lobe contains a larger indentation. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer margin of the right lobe; the left lobe shows a convex outer margin with a higher rate of curvature change towards the proximal end.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 10 dark, roughly circular pixel clusters on the high-intensity white background of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least three distinct, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions crossing the white pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged contour and material-loss at the distal tip of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bilateral pigmentation asymmetry; the right lobe is primarily high-intensity white while the left lobe is primarily low-intensity black.
